Questions

What is the median annual wage for Carpenters in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Carpenters in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $50,260.

What is the hourly median for Carpenters in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Carpenters in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $24.16.

How many Carpenters work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 2,540 wage-and-salary Carpenters in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Carpenters in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.46. Values above 1.00 mean Carpenters are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Carpenters in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Carpenters in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $53,850.

How does Austin's Carpenters median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($50,260) is $30,180 lower than Chicago ($80,440) and $26,150 lower than Seattle ($76,410). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
